+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+MAX_NAME_LENGTH = 50
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_rename_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw_id = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw_id, str) or not raw_id.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    raw_name = params.get("name")
+    if not isinstance(raw_name, str):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid name"}
+    name = raw_name.strip()
+    if not 1 <= len(name) <= MAX_NAME_LENGTH:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid name"}
+    user = users.rename_user(int(raw_id), name)
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user

+from app.api.handlers import handle_get_user, handle_rename_user
+
+
+def test_get_user_ok():
+    assert handle_get_user({"id": "1"}) == (200, {"id": 1, "name": "Ada Lovelace", "email": "ada@example.com"})
+
+
+def test_get_user_invalid():
+    assert handle_get_user({"id": "abc"})[0] == 400
+
+
+def test_get_user_missing():
+    assert handle_get_user({"id": "99"})[0] == 404
+
+
+def test_rename_user_ok_and_visible_through_get_user():
+    status, user = handle_rename_user({"id": "2", "name": "  Linus B. Torvalds  "})
+    assert status == 200
+    assert user == {"id": 2, "name": "Linus B. Torvalds", "email": "linus@example.com"}
+    assert handle_get_user({"id": "2"}) == (200, user)
+
+
+def test_rename_user_id_missing():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"name": "New Name"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_id_not_string():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": 1, "name": "New Name"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_id_not_digits():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "abc", "name": "New Name"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_name_not_string():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "1", "name": 42}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_name_empty_after_trim():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "1", "name": "   "}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_name_too_long():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "1", "name": "x" * 51}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_name_max_length():
+    name = "y" * 50
+    status, user = handle_rename_user({"id": "3", "name": name})
+    assert status == 200
+    assert user["name"] == name
+    assert handle_get_user({"id": "3"}) == (200, user)
+
+
+def test_rename_user_not_found():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "99", "name": "New Name"}) == (404, {"error": "not found"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_validates_name_before_existence():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "99", "name": ""}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
